orientation.basis: The main overlaid Latin text has level horizontal baselines and reads left-to-right without rotation. An oblique background inscription follows the perspective of the illustrated surface but does not require rotating the full image.

blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame with a tilted, densely layered background of dark gray, brown, black, orange, and red angular structures.

Thick black curved forms intrude from the upper-left and upper-right corners. A bright circular orange-red opening and concentrated yellow-red flame-like textures occupy the central and lower-middle background.
An oblique worn white stencil-like inscription appears above and left of center, with one smaller six-character line over a much larger two-character line.
A compact blue-white composite glyph followed by uppercase white text is centered immediately above a wide near-black title plaque.
The lower half contains a narrow beveled title plaque overlapping a larger translucent dark body panel. Gold-orange outlines, projecting side tabs, and mirrored diagonal accents define the borders.

The upper body block comprises four centered lines. A small gold-brown chamfered plaque carrying white uppercase text bridges a central divider, followed by one centered lower condition line and an orange uppercase bottom line.
A small red glyph-like stroke appears just above the title plaque at left-center, but its edges merge with adjacent red pictorial texture and part of its lower area is obscured by the plaque.
The diagonal orange side strokes are physically integrated with the panel outlines and favor border ornament rather than independent symbols.

readConfidence.materialText: Very high for ALL, the title, all main body text, AND, and MISSION TASK; high for the oblique SECTOR and 04 inscription. The first occurrence is visibly Landing Zone with uppercase Z, while the parenthetical occurrence is Landing zone with lowercase z.
readConfidence.punctuation: Very high for the full stop and opening parenthesis in Reinforced. (There is, the closing-parenthesis/full-stop sequence in Room)., and the final full stop after destroyed.
readConfidence.iconMorphology: High for the top glyph's concentric rings and upright silhouette and for the labeled AND plaque; medium-high for fine separations within the small white form because glow softens its edges.

classificationConfidence.componentFamily: High for a portrait card-like printed component based solely on the framed title-and-body layout.
classificationConfidence.exactComponent: Medium: the literal MISSION TASK and THE SUPPLY ROUTE label-title pairing is clear, but no external canonical component identity is asserted.

uncertainties: The first large character beneath SECTOR has an oval stencil form shared by uppercase O and numeral 0; it is transcribed as 0 with medium-high rather than absolute confidence.
The small red glyph-like stroke above the title plaque could be a partly obscured character or merely flame-like background texture, so it remains [illegible] rather than being promoted to a numeral.
The blue-white glyph's semantic identity is not established by the adjacent word ALL; its white element could visually resemble a rounded upright figure, pawn, bottle, or plume-like marker.
ALL is clearly printed beside the glyph, but the pixels alone do not establish their exact semantic relationship.
The printed AND establishes the central plaque's connector text, but the pixels do not establish whether the plaque is only a decorative separator or a distinct functional control.
The mirrored orange panel-side marks appear border-integrated and are not promoted to functional symbols.
MISSION TASK occurs once at lower center; it is represented in both typeLine and lowerCenter to encode its apparent role and visible position, not as two separate printed instances.
